text:
mike_ml: heads-up — ran 1h canary AB for model v2-quant4 vs v1-prod on 5% traffic. Posting topline.
sara_research: results?
mike_ml: latency p50 72ms → 110ms (1.53x), p95 320ms → 480ms. Quality (ROUGE-L) delta -0.9% absolute, but embedding cosine mean delta -0.6%.
evan_platform: those latency increases are concerning. What's our auto-fallback rule again?
jamie_sre: current rule: fallback if latency ratio > 1.4 for p95 for >5m AND quality degradation > 1.0% on primary eval. See snippet.
mike_ml: posting snippet:
```
{ "fallback": { "p95_latency_ratio_threshold": 1.4, "quality_drop_pct": 1.0, "min_eval_samples": 5000, "window_mins": 10 }}
```
sara_research: stats: A/B z-test p=0.07 for ROUGE-L, but embedding delta significant p=0.02 on convo slices. Some slices (long-docs >4k tokens) regressed 2.8%.
evan_platform: long-doc slice is high priority for enterprise customers—can we limit rollout to non-long-doc profiles?
mike_ml: yes we can route with feature flags. Proposal: holdback 100% of long-doc slice until we fix kv-cache warmup.
jamie_sre: suggest soft-fallback: reduce traffic to v2 by 50% and enable shadow comparisons for 24h, auto-fallback if slice delta > 2% with p<0.05.
sara_research: also saw higher hallucination rate on instruction-following tests (hallucination_metric +0.4%). Not huge but correlated with quantization buckets.
ops-bot: deploy v2-quant4 canary started at 2024-09-12T09:12Z on pool-gamma :rocket:
evan_platform: action items: 1) implement slice holdback rule, 2) change auto-fallback rule to include slice-aware thresholds, 3) run additional 4h warmup with KV prefill.
mike_ml: I can land PR for thresholds and routing by EOD. Will add a circuit-breaker modeling that requires both latency and quality signals to trip.
sara_research: small note — for significance use stratified bootstrapping for skewed seqlen distribution.
jamie_sre: agreed. Also add metric hysteresis: require 3 consecutive windows failing (10m each) before hard fallback.
evan_platform: ok let's roll that plan. :thumbsup: If anyone objects speak up in 30m.
sara_research: no objections. I'll prepare slice report.
mike_ml: thanks — tagging @ops-team to monitor. rolling PR -> canary config after green CI.
